question: A cylindrical water tank which is open on the top side has a height h meters and a diameter 21 m. The cost of plastering the tank is ₹1,36,125 at the rate of ₹275/m², then find the height of the tank. (π = (22)/(7) )
solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of the tank= 21 meters

Cost of plastering = ₹1,36,125

Rate of plastering = ₹275/m²

**Formula used:**

Cost of plastering = (Curved Surface area + tank bottom area) × Rate

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b152e8c117a9fae3b469f00130f28f8ef6801d085f2b097d2999f05cc5ae3828.png] 

Cost of plastering = (Curved Surface area + tank bottom area) × Rate

⇒ ₹1,36,125 = (πdh + πr²)× ₹275

⇒ (πdh + πr2) = ₹1,36,125 / ₹275

⇒ (πdh + πr2) = 495 m²

⇒ (22/7) × 21 × h + (22/7) × 21/2 × 21/2 = 495

⇒ 66h + 346.5 = 495

⇒ h = (495 - 346.5) / 66

⇒ h = 2.25 meters

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
